brand.company: Shenzhen Southern Machinery Sales and Service Co., Ltd.

unit_rule.zh: 整机 / 单台设备：所有项目逐台 100 % 检验。
unit_rule.en: Machines / single units: every item, 100 % per unit.

lot_rule.zh: 同型号批量小件（飞达、配件）：标“每批抽”项目按 ISO 2859-1 / GB/T 2828.1 一般检验水平 II 抽样；CR 项 100 %；MA AQL 0.65；MI AQL 1.5。
lot_rule.en: Lots of identical small units (feeders, parts): items marked 'per lot' sampled to ISO 2859-1 / GB/T 2828.1 general level II; CR items 100 %; MA AQL 0.65; MI AQL 1.5.

zh: 任一 CR（致命）项不合格：整台 / 整批不放行，整改后全项复检。
MA（主要）项不合格：返工后复检该项及关联项，全部合格方可放行。
仅 MI（次要）项不合格且 ≤ 2 项：可由 QC 主管签字特采放行，并在备注写明处置。
NA 须在备注写明原因；含 ★ 建议值或“待确认”的表格只能作草稿，不得用于正式放行。
en: Any CR (critical) item fails: unit / lot not released; fix and re-inspect all items.
MA (major) item fails: rework, re-inspect that item and related items; release only when all pass.
Only MI (minor) items fail and ≤ 2: QC manager may sign a concession release with the disposition in the remark.
NA needs a reason in the remark; a sheet with ★ suggested values or TBD items is a draft and cannot be used for formal release.
